title: Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections - Remote
text:
**Optum Insight** is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections is the senior operational leader responsible for domestic hospital and professional collections performance across assigned client portfolios. This role directly leads the domestic collections organization and is accountable for cash acceleration, accounts receivable resolution, aging and inventory reduction, productivity, quality, workforce effectiveness, and achievement of client and operational commitments.

The Senior Director works closely with offshore/global delivery leadership to coordinate collections activities across domestic and global operations, including alignment of work allocation, performance expectations, quality standards, escalation pathways, and reporting.

In addition to direct responsibility for domestic collections, this position provides strategic and operational oversight across the broader back-end revenue cycle, including billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting. These functions do not report directly to this position. The Senior Director is responsible for ensuring strong cross-functional coordination, identifying dependencies and barriers, facilitating resolution of issues impacting collections performance, and promoting accountability for overall back-end revenue cycle outcomes.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Domestic Collections Leadership and Performance
 + Provide direct leadership and accountability for domestic collections operations across hospital and professional accounts receivable portfolios
 + Lead a large, distributed organization through directors, managers, supervisors, and frontline collections teams
 + Own domestic collections performance related to cash, days in A/R, aging, inventory reduction, productivity, quality, cost to collect, service levels, and client commitments
 + Establish priorities for collections activities based on payer, aging, balance, account complexity, recovery opportunity, and client requirements
 + Ensure appropriate allocation of staffing and resources to maximize cash recovery and reduce unresolved A/R
 + Maintain disciplined management of aged, high-dollar, complex, and escalated inventories, including underpayments, stalled claims, administrative denials, payer escalations, and accounts requiring cross-functional intervention
 + Hold operational leaders accountable for established performance expectations and lead corrective action and performance recovery when results fall below targeted levels
* Global Collections Partnership
 + Partner closely with offshore/global collections leadership to align domestic and global collections activities
 + Establish consistent expectations for work allocation, work queues, productivity, quality, documentation, escalation, and performance reporting
 + Align domestic and global work based on account complexity, payer requirements, system access, client commitments, resource capabilities, and automation opportunities
 + Identify and resolve gaps in ownership, handoffs, and accountability that may impede collections performance
 + Maintain effective operating rhythms with global leadership to ensure visibility into performance, capacity, risks, and emerging client needs
* Back Operations Oversight and Integration
 + Provide strategic and operational oversight across billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting, while maintaining direct leadership accountability for domestic collections
 + Partner with functional leaders to monitor performance, identify risks and dependencies, and address issues that may affect cash flow, aging, collections, or client commitments
 + Facilitate cross-functional resolution of issues involving billing delays, claim defects, denials, payment posting, payer behavior, system access, or workflow breakdowns
 + Establish clear mechanisms for escalating significant performance or operational barriers and monitoring remediation through resolution
 + Promote effective integration across back-end revenue cycle functions and appropriate accountability for end-to-end outcomes
 + Identify recurring operational issues and partner with appropriate revenue cycle leaders to address upstream and downstream root causes
* Performance Management and Analytics
 + Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly operating rhythms, including performance reviews, dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, and corrective action plans
 + Monitor and manage key revenue cycle performance indicators, including cash collections, days in A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, denial trends, cost to collect, staffing, and forecast performance
 + Analyze results by client, payer, account type, aging category, work queue, team, and other relevant dimensions to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
 + Establish transparent capacity and workforce plans that connect inventory, expected cash, productivity, staffing, training, attrition, and global delivery assumptions
 + Use data to distinguish performance issues driven by capacity from those caused by process, technology, payer behavior, access limitations, or upstream revenue cycle issues
 + Translate operational data into clear actions, priorities, and performance improvement plans
* Operational Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement
 + Identify opportunities to standardize and improve collections workflows, work queues, payer strategies, account segmentation, documentation practices, escalation processes, and operating procedures
 + Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Automation teams to identify and prioritize opportunities to improve collections efficiency and effectiveness
 + Sponsor workflow redesign and automation initiatives that reduce manual activity, improve work prioritization, accelerate account resolution, and strengthen quality
 + Support appropriate adoption of analytics, predictive capabilities, automation, and AI-enabled tools within collections operations
 + Establish appropriate human review, exception handling, quality validation, and operational controls for automated processes
 + Identify recurring collections and denial root causes and partner with the appropriate operational leaders to address issues affecting revenue realization
* Client, Payer and Executive Leadership
 + Serve as the senior operational leader for domestic collections in discussions with client revenue cycle executives, internal executive leadership, and other key stakeholders
 + Lead client performance discussions, operational reviews, remediation planning, and executive escalations related to collections performance
 + Communicate operational performance, risks, root causes, corrective actions, and expected recovery timelines clearly and effectively
 + Coordinate payer escalation strategies when payer behavior contributes to significant payment delays, denials, underpayments, or administrative burden
 + Support new client transitions, expansions, and other operational initiatives involving collections or back-end revenue cycle capabilities
 + Partner across Finance, Client Management, Sales, Technology, Product, Human Capital, Compliance, and other operational functions to achieve client and organizational objectives
* People Leadership and Workforce Development
 + Build, develop, and retain a strong domestic collections leadership team, including directors, managers, supervisors, and emerging leaders
 + Oversee recruiting, selection, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and retention strategies
 + Establish appropriate spans of control, role expectations, career pathways, and capability requirements based on operational complexity
 + Ensure leaders consistently communicate performance expectations, provide meaningful coaching and feedback, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps in a timely manner
 + Foster a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and performance-oriented culture across domestic teams and in partnership with global operations
 + Partner with Human Capital and other stakeholders on workforce planning, organizational change, employee relations, and other personnel matters
* Risk, Compliance and Operational Controls
 + Ensure collections activities comply with applicable federal and state requirements, payer requirements, contractual obligations, client policies, privacy requirements, and company controls
 + Maintain appropriate controls related to account handling, documentation, system access, quality, escalation, and other revenue cycle processes
 + Identify operational and compliance risks and ensure appropriate escalation and remediation
 + Partner with Compliance, Legal, Human Capital, and client leadership as appropriate to address identified risks

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of progressive healthcare revenue cycle experience
* 5+ years of experience in a leadership role with responsibility for operational performance
* 5+ years of experience leading accounts receivable follow-up and collections operations within a complex hospital, health system, physician, or outsourced revenue cycle environment
* 5+ years of experience leading large, geographically distributed teams through multiple levels of management
* 5+ years of experience managing operational performance using cash, A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, staffing, and other key revenue cycle measures
* 5+ years of experience leading operational improvement, standardization, transformation, or performance recovery initiatives
* 5+ years of experience partnering with senior executives, clients, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders
* 3+ years of experience working across domestic and offshore/global delivery environments

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience across both hospital/facility and professional revenue cycle operations
* 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-client, or large health system revenue cycle operations
* 3+ years of experience working with Epic and/or other major EHR and patient accounting platforms
* 3+ years of experience leveraging workflow technology, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled capabilities to improve revenue cycle performance

* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $159,300 - $273,200 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

**Application Deadline**: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.
